title: Ghost
paragraphs: “Honestly… I don’t think it’s an unwinnable fight, but protecting the entire country at the same time is difficult.”
“Bubububu.”
“Shut up! Even if you multiply endlessly and claim every one of you is the real one, there’s no way I’m giving up!”
“That being said… we’re enduring within this barrier thanks to the Holy Weapon’s protection from magic and power draining… but who knows how long that will last.”
“Yeah, I hate to say it, but like Motoyasu mentioned, we should consider abandoning the capital.”
“…Understood.”
The queen seems to have made her decision.
“I will take responsibility for the disaster caused by Aultcray. Please, let us minimize the damage as much as possible. Please… I beg you.”
“Are you really sure about this?”

“If we want even a few of our people to survive, we can’t just sit idly by here. In the past, Aultcray had to make decisions too. If sacrifices must be made for the sake of the country, I am prepared to take responsibility for them!”
Right after her resolute declaration… Father’s Full Moon Shield began to wane, its protective range shrinking as magic started seeping through. That magic was about to hit us and the queen.
“Watch out!”
Just as Father reached out, the staff held by the red-black pig began to glow and drifted in front of the queen.
“Buhi!? Bububu!”

The red-black pig tried to interfere with its sinister power, but though Father’s shield was weakening, it still blocked the force, preventing the interference. It seems the staff itself was resisting. Then, light overflowed from the staff, forming the shape of a person. …The one standing there was Trash.
He was supposed to have been dealt with—why is he here? With a calm expression, he gazed at the queen and Fiancée.
“King…”
“Aultcray…”
“Father…?”

Trash remained silent, extending the staff toward the queen. Then, he turned a harsh gaze toward the red-black pig. As the queen hesitantly reached out, Trash placed the staff in her hand. And then… the staff transferred its light to the queen. Satisfied, Trash smiled faintly, embraced Fiancée, saluted Éclair, then turned once more to the queen and gave her a firm nod.
“Father…”
“…I understand. Aultcray, I know what you want to convey. I will do my utmost—for the world, for our country, in your place!”
Perhaps satisfied with her response, Trash faded away.
“Bububububu!”
The red-black pig, enraged by the situation, went into a furious rampage.
Oh? Its clones are disappearing. Since it can no longer use magic or skills, it seems to be compensating by growing absurdly muscular.
“That king… maybe after he died, he realized the truth of the country’s situation and started worrying about it?”
“Most likely. Otherwise, he wouldn’t have handed the staff to the queen.”
“It’s a bit dramatic, but this gives us an opening! That thing has no trump cards left!”

The ritual spell formation still remains, centered around the red-black pig. So it wasn’t just the staff. Honestly, the sheer complexity of this formation is beyond ridiculous—I’m at a loss for words.
“You really have no intention of giving up, huh… Honestly, I’d rather you just surrender and dispel the magic.”
“Bubububububu! Bufuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!”
The red-black pig is still determined to fight.
What even is its total level at this point? More importantly, how is it still alive? Its body looks like it should be falling apart.
“To minimize the damage as much as possible! Heroes, please lend us your strength!”
“Yeah! This is all something we brought upon ourselves.”
“We’ll take responsibility.”
“Yeah, well… it’s all that idiot’s fault, though.”
“Here we go!”
With that battle cry, I unleashed my skill.
“Bunker Shot V!”

Itsuki rushed in close to the red-black pig and fired a close-range skill he had used in the previous cycle. Something like a stake was launched from his gun. With a loud crack, the barrier protecting the red-black pig shattered.
“Just as expected. Well, at this point, it’s nothing more than a paper-thin shield.”
The skill Itsuki fired pierced through and struck the red-black pig.
“Coordinated fire is nice and all, but I’m going to steal the spotlight! Brionac X!”
“Whoa!”
I shoved Itsuki aside and slammed the red-black pig with my attack. Ren, the queen, and my rivals all stood in stunned silence.
“B-BuhiIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII—!!”
Taking the full force of my ultimate Brionac, the red-black pig was obliterated. At last, the problem with Melromarc is finally resolved.
“Ah, geez… Well, I guess that finally settles it?”
“Are you sure? That ominous cloud is still hanging around.”
Half of the castle is already gone. Ren muttered as he gazed up at the dark clouds looming in the sky.
“We might have no choice but to purify it with the ritual magic, ‘Sanctuary.’”
The queen responded while looking up at the sky.
“So even after taking down the cause, things don’t just automatically resolve themselves…”
“If this were a game, everything would just go back to normal in an instant.”
Father gave a wry smile as he agreed.
“For now, we should check on the soldiers in the courtyard and see how the people in the city are—”
Just as we were all about to leave—
“BuhIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII!”
From where the red-black pig had been, a semi-transparent… crimson swine appeared!
“W-What!?”
Everyone, myself included, turned around with dumbfounded expressions.
“W-What is this…?”
“Buhiiii… Bubububu…”
A semi-transparent crimson swine? What in the world is happening?
“D-Don’t tell me… you’re saying you possessed that girl earlier and controlled her?”
“Bububu, Bubu, Bububububu!”
The ghostly crimson swine let out cries as if affirming the claim.
Still… its presence and appearance are even more sinister than the red-black pig.
“Buhi Bububu.”
“Wha…? It’s devouring the souls of everyone inside the castle…? Then, does that mean those sacrificed in the ritual…?”
“Bububu, Bububu.”
“That too, but it was also consuming and enslaving the souls of the demons it summoned… What kind of monster is this person?!”
“I see… Now I understand what Aultcray was instructing.”
“Sister… how could you…?”
“What does this mean?”
I can’t understand a single thing that crimson swine is saying. It’s just oinking incessantly, so I’d rather just finish it off quickly.

“Listen, Motoyasu-kun. That princess’s ghost used the king’s soul and the power of the staff after you killed her. She then took over the puppet that the Three Heroes Church had brought in, controlling the new pope and even the king’s body double.”

W-What? So the crimson swine came back as a ghost? Even after being killed, it revives? Just how persistently does it cling to life? That thing is Filo-chan’s enemy. No matter how many times it comes back, even as a ghost, I’ll kill it.

“On top of that, it consumed the souls of those in the castle to grow stronger, enslaved them, performed demon summoning rituals to expand its territory, and continued devouring souls within its range to reach this level of power.”
“That’s a complete monster. Can an ordinary human really do all this with just their soul?”

I don’t want there to be more of these things. Still, the crimson swine survived even after being executed by that pig king. Considering that, maybe it’s not surprising that it came back as a ghost. I’ll kill it anyway.
“Buhiiiifuuuuuuuuuuu…!”
Light seemed to be gathering toward the crimson swine from all over the country. At the same time, we felt a strange kind of shock ripple through us.
How should I describe it? It’s not a physical impact, but it feels like my insides are being forcibly ripped out.
“Ugh… guh… my strength…!”
“It’s not just magic power—something else is being drained. Kou, this is scary!”
“Ugh…”
I can still endure it, but the filolials seem to be in distress.
“Na! It’s forcefully sucking out our souls! Its power is overwhelming, but we have to endure it, na!”
My rival spread his glowing wings to shield his assistant and the mole.
“Kh… I’ll recast Crescent Shield!”
“Aultcray… lend us your strength!”
“I’ll help too!”
Father, the queen, and Éclair combined their powers to form a barrier. I feel a little lighter now.
“Malty! What do you take the people of this country for?! Just because you’re dead doesn’t mean you can do as you please!”
Despite the queen’s outcry, the crimson swine merely sneered mockingly.
“Bububububu.”
“The world exists only because of me, and it serves me…? Don’t be ridiculous!”
Ren, furious, raised his sword toward the sky.
“Hundred Sword X!”
A hundred swords rained down, targeting the crimson swine.
However… the crimson swine remained completely unfazed.
“Ren-san, the enemy is an incorporeal ghost! Silver Bullet X!”

Itsuki unleashed a skill that was effective against demons and spirits. But even that didn’t reach the crimson swine. It used a demon-like figure as a shield, causing the attack to explode before it could penetrate, nullifying the effect.
